applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: None directly applicable to tax-exempt International Companies; the Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) and Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus) are the operative regional trade and investment facilitation instruments.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 2008 (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018 and the International Companies (Amendment) Regulations 2019); Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2000; Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2000; Anti-Money Laundering and Suppression of Financing of Terrorism Act 2018; Anti-Money Laundering and Suppression of Financing of Terrorism Regulations 2018; relevant Financial Intelligence Unit Beneficial Ownership Guidelines and Compliance Directives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Samoa Licensed International Company Service Provider / Resident Agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Per the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit and International Company Registrar requirements, all identified non-resident owners, ultimate beneficial owners, directors, and authorized signatories must be screened before incorporation and on a continuing basis against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the Australian DFAT Autonomous Sanctions Lists, and the Samoa Domestic Sanctions List. PEP status is determined using an internationally recognized risk database (e.g., World-Check, Refinitiv, or equivalent); identifiable PEPs, former PEPs, and relatives or close associates of PEPs require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth documentation, and senior management approval. Screening results are timestamped, logged, and retained for at least five years in the resident agent’s AML/CFT records.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry – Official eServices Portal (SICR eServices)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Registry filings are accepted in English. Samoan-language corporate names are also permitted; where a name is submitted in a non-Latin script, it must be transliterated into Latin script and accompanied by a certified transliteration certificate. The name must not be identical or misleadingly similar to any protected name in Samoa, and must include one of the statutory corporate suffixes: Limited, Incorporated, Corporation, or an acceptable abbreviation (Ltd., Inc., Corp., or the equivalent).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant receives an electronic notice identifying the basis of refusal. The proposed incorporator or licensed agent may, within 14 calendar days, submit to the Registrar of International Companies a formal review request, attaching any regulatory consents or ministerial approvals relevant to the rejected token, together with a written legal submission. The Registrar must issue a final administrative decision within 15 business days of receipt of that review request. If the final decision remains adverse, an appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Samoa under the applicable Judicial Review rules, which must be filed within 30 calendar days. A single 30-day extension of a name reservation may be requested before expiration, subject to the applicable extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the registered office. Under the International Companies Act 2008, every International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa at a street-address location, which must be the office of a licensed resident agent. A standalone virtual office or post office box may be used solely as an ancillary correspondence address, never as the statutory registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low, estimated at below 5% annual probability for a Standard-Risk digital health app issuer in its first year of incorporation, reflecting the Financial Intelligence Unit risk-based supervisory framework. The Registrar and Financial Intelligence Unit retain unrestricted powers of unannounced inspection; the probability increases to 15–25% if a suspicious transaction report is made, if fitness biometric data monetization is deemed to constitute medical-device or health-care activity requiring appropriate licensing, or if in-app payment routing creates an assessment of regulated financial services.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), Parts I–IV (incorporation, memorandum, registered office, directors and secretary)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association on Form IC-01, together with signed consent forms and statutory declaration of compliance
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed under the International Companies Act 1987; shares may be issued with no par value or partly paid, and no escrow or capital deposit requirement applies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the shares subscribed in the memorandum and articles of association be duly allotted to the founding shareholder in accordance with the International Companies Act 1987. RESOLVED, that the registered office and registered agent designated in the incorporation filing be and are hereby adopted as the statutory registered office and agent. RESOLVED, that the individuals named in the consent forms be appointed as director, secretary, and registered agent of the Company, each to act until replaced by subsequent resolution. RESOLVED, that the articles of association be approved, and that the director be authorised to open corporate bank accounts, execute digital payment merchant agreements, and take all steps to complete registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application through the MCIL Companies Registry e-service or in writing to the Registrar of International Companies specifying the proposed company name and its suffix, and instruct the registered agent to verify availability against the register of international companies and reserved names.
required_dossiers: Identity and contact details of the subscriber or registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is considered undesirable or too similar, the Registrar will issue a name objection; submit a fresh application with up to three alternative names, or file an appeal within 14 days under the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent / Notary Public authorised in Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association in conformity with the International Companies Act 1987, including share class, registered office address, and object clause for digital health software. The subscriber and each officer execute the documents, and the registered agent's notarization and consent are affixed.
required_dossiers: Proposed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of first director and secretary
Consent to act from director, secretary and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar rejects the executed documents for formal irregularity, amend and re-execute them and file a corrected version; notarial defects are cured by obtaining a fresh jurat before a Samoan notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment, Fee Payment and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the notarized Memorandum and Articles together with a statutory declaration of compliance by the registered agent and the prescribed government fee. Pay the fee by bank draft or portal payment; the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation upon satisfactory review.
required_dossiers: Statutory declaration of compliance by registered agent
Proof of payment of USD 250 state filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a requisition is issued, respond through the registered agent with corrected documents within 14 days; if the fee is underpaid, settle the shortfall and file an updated fee schedule.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions, Registered Office Recordal and Bank/Payment Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Registered Agent; commercial bank or licensed payment processor
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pass the first board resolution to adopt the First Board Resolution, ratify the appointment of officers, approve the registered office, and authorize operational bank accounts and Apple IAP / Google Play Billing merchant agreements. File the registered office confirmation with the Registrar and sign relevant onboarding declarations with payment processors.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or payment processor requests enhanced due diligence, provide apostilled certified copies of constitutional documents and evidence of the registered agent; if the Registrar is not satisfied regarding registered office, rectify the address and file an updated notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Health — Digital Health and Data Governance Unit (reference only; no industrial permit required)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating license required for non-physical digital health application; general software development is exempt from manufacturing/industry licensing under Samoa law.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) — Environmental Impact Assessment Unit
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-only software activity with no construction, land disturbance, discharge or emission triggers under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC discharge sources from the digital telemetry service; any office waste must be handled through municipal waste systems and battery/e-waste must be exported or recycled in accordance with Waste Management Act 2016.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety clearance or building occupancy certificate required for a virtual registered office; if a physical workspace is established, obtain Fire and Emergency Services Authority Samoa clearance, a building occupancy permit from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure, and occupational safety compliance under the Samoa Occupational Safety and Health Act.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA); online taxpayer portal available at https://www.sra.gov.ws (SRA e-Services / Taxpayer Access Point for TIN application, VAGST registration, and monthly filing).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) must obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) from the Samoa Revenue Authority via the licensed registered agent. Application forms (Company TIN Application) must be accompanied by: (1) Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar of International Companies; (2) Memorandum and Articles of Association; (3) Certificate of Registered Office and Resident Agent in Samoa; and (4) directors/shareholders particulars and beneficial ownership declaration. TIN issuance typically occurs within 3-5 business days. Where the IC has Samoa-connected taxable supplies it must separately register for VAGST (VAGST registration number) using the same portal; offshore-only ICs are otherwise not required to file income tax returns due to statutory exemption.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone – International Companies incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 enjoy statutory exemption from Samoa income tax and stamp duty on offshore activities, provided no business is carried on in Samoa and no Samoa-source income is derived. Such ICs remain subject to VAGST on taxable supplies connected with Samoa (including certain digital services) and to annual government fees payable to the Registrar.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists under Samoa law. Available elections include: (1) voluntary VAGST registration for non-resident remote/digital suppliers (simplified remote supplier registration); (2) conversion of an IC into a local (domestic) company under the International Companies Act 1987, which terminates the tax-exempt status and subjects the entity to standard Samoa income tax at 27%, VAGST, and general tax administration rules; and (3) redomiciliation of a foreign company into Samoa as an International Company without re-incorporation, preserving the tax-exempt classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 1997, administered by the Samoa Revenue Authority.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 50,000 annual taxable turnover of supplies connected with Samoa. A remote/non-resident supplier of electronic, digital, and telecommunication services to Samoan consumers must register for VAGST once the value of Samoa-connected supplies exceeds WST 50,000 in any 12-month period.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not operate a mandatory real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control (CTC), or API-based digital stamping regime as of 2024. Registered suppliers must issue compliant VAGST tax invoices containing prescribed particulars (supplier name and TIN/VAGST number, recipient details, description, date, amount, and tax charged), retain records for 7 years, and file monthly VAGST returns electronically through the SRA online portal. The SRA may require additional data on cross-border digital transactions but no government pre-clearance of invoices is mandated.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% VAGST) is available for: (1) goods physically exported from Samoa within 28 days of supply; (2) services supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Samoa at the time of supply, provided the services are performed wholly outside Samoa or the contract is negotiated and effectively performed offshore; (3) international transportation of goods or passengers; and (4) supplies connected with foreign aid or diplomatic arrangements. A health/fitness app tracker IC may zero-rate subscription and licensing fees only where the direct recipient is a non-resident, the contract is executed offshore, the service benefits are consumed outside Samoa, and consideration is settled in foreign currency. B2C downloads through Apple IAP or Google Play Billing are generally treated as imported digital services subject to Samoa VAGST when consumed in Samoa.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA/Samoa Customs electronic declaration or equivalent export lodgement)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure of goods from Samoa (for goods exports)
Commercial Invoice and VAGST Tax Invoice issued to the non-resident buyer showing 0%
Inward Remittance Certificate or Foreign Exchange Bank Credit Advice from a licensed Samoa commercial bank evidencing receipt of foreign currency funds
Service Contract, License, or Subscription Agreement with the offshore customer (for digital services)
Supporting evidence of offshore performance and consumption (e.g., server logs, geo-location/IP records, user residency data)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Samoa Revenue Authority may conduct audit review within the 7-year assessment period and claw back any incorrectly zero-rated supply by reassessing the full 15% VAGST plus statutory interest and late payment penalties. Fraudulent or deliberate false zero-rating claims attract penalty tax of up to 200% of the tax evaded and criminal prosecution under the Tax Administration Act 2014 and the VAGST Act 1997, with potential fines and imprisonment up to 5 years for directors and responsible officers. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days constitutes an exchange control offence under the Exchange Control Act 1976, punishable by fine, imprisonment, and forfeiture of the unrepatriated foreign currency proceeds, in addition to SRA tax adjustments.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) - the sole monetary authority, banking supervisor, and exchange control administrator under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984 and the Exchange Control Act 1976.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is a partially convertible currency. Current-account payments, including trade in goods and services, are in practice freely processed through authorized dealers. Capital-account transactions, WST-denominated borrowings by foreign-owned entities, and any arrangement that creates a WST liability to a non-resident require prior exchange control approval. An International Company (IC) organized under Samoa's International Companies Act 2012 is treated as offshore and non-resident; where the Health Fitness App Tracker entity keeps its operating treasury in USD/EUR via non-resident settlement accounts, profit remittance and shareholder distributions can occur without WST conversion or CBS approval. Tajikistan? No. There is no freely floating retail offshore WST market; all WST quotations must be made by CBS-licensed authorized dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control framework, exporters of physical goods must repatriate and sell export proceeds to an authorized dealer in Samoa within the period specified by CBS (generally 30 days after receipt). Digital invisible exports, including app-store subscriptions, in-app purchases, and biometric telemetry services, are not captured by the physical goods surrender rule. Where the App Tracker IC receives USD/AUD/EUR directly from Apple and Google treasury intermediaries and neither routes the funds through a WST account nor lands them to a Samoa domestic bank, no statutory surrender/conversion obligation arises. If the IC voluntarily repatriates overseas funds to its Samoa authorized-dealer account, the foreign currency must be either maintained in an approved foreign-currency account or sold to the dealer within the prescribed surrender timeline, unless the IC has obtained an offshore company exemption.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / USD Operational Settlement Account
Operational WST Account / Foreign-Currency Current Account
USD Foreign-Currency Account / Clearing Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-Low. Samoa does not maintain a domestic electronic money institution (EMI) or payment-institution licensing regime, so fully digital offshore EMIs are not authorized deposit-takers in Samoa. However, a Samoa International Company may pragmatically use an EU/UK/FATF-jurisdiction EMI (e.g., an EMI licensed under PSD2 with a sponsor bank) to collect USD mounts? To be corrected. The platform is best used as a secondary collection and disbursement rail for Apple/Google IAP payouts and low-risk service-provider payments. Because the IC earns active fintech software revenue and presents a low AML inherent risk, mainstream international EMIs can open accounts remotely for the corporate entity; still, the primary statutory and banking relationship should remain with a CBS-licensed authorized dealer to ensure exchange-control compliance and documentary credibility for any future Samoan court or tax authority inquiry.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not absolutely mandatory, but CBS-licensed banks require a real-person interactive interview via secure videoconference at minimum; a purely automated or email-only onboarding is generally rejected. For an International Company, the Samoa registered agent must certify the incumbency and board resolutions, and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) must pass a life-check interview. Where the UBO is a discretionary trust, the trustee and appointor must be disclosed and, in practice, one director or a C-suite officer must be physically present in Samoa for the original account-opening submission. Banks accept foreign notarization and apostille, but account committee approval is faster if a director or registered agent attends a face-to-face interview at the commercial bank's Apia head office.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Zero-tax offshore International Company with nominee share capital and trust ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum & Articles of Association; current Certificate of Incumbency from the Samoa International Financial Authority incumbent registered agent; full trust deed with any subsequent amendments registered in the IC's minute book; UBO declaration with passport, residence and source-of-wealth evidence; CRS/FATCA self-certification for the corporate entity and all 25%+ beneficial owners; letter from the Samoa International Financial Authority confirming tax-exempt status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Health Fitness App biometric data concentration in the United States / EU / China generating a data-protection adverse media check
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: App Privacy Policy and End-User License Agreement; DPO appointment statement and DPO contact details; data-processing agreements with Apple, Google, AWS/Azure or equivalent cloud providers; SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001/27701 attestation/certificate; signed data-privacy compliance questionnaire prepared by the company's legal counsel; certification that no health-data research is conducted without IRB/ethics approval.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity cross-border payment flow originating from App Store Connect and Google Play Treasury Centres rather than a named end-client invoice
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apple Developer Program Entered into License Agreement; Google Play Developer Distribution Agreement; a chronological payment and settlement register matching monthly App Store Connect Financial Reports (green report) and Google Play Financial Statements; bank statements from [[intermediary bank accounts]] evidencing the net settlement received from Apple Distribution International Ltd / Google Ireland Ltd; a legal opinion from Samoan counsel classifying app revenue as an 'invisible export' exempt from goods surrender.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Immediate loan-back or dividend prepayment to settlor/shareholder after capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current-year board minutes authorizing the distribution or loan arrangement; full underlying commercial contract for any related-party loan; funds-flow statement showing original share-capital entry, app-registered P&L, and a retained-earnings computation; audited financial statements from a licensed accountant; declaration of arm's-length pricing signed by directors; evidence that the transaction will not create a WST on-shore liability unless formal CBS approval has first been obtained.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocols for an International Company: the corporate subscriber or trust settlor remits the paid-up capital from a licensed financial institution in the name of the beneficial owner, using the recipient IC's full legal name and registered office. The wire should reference 'Share Capital Contribution / WS-IC / Allotment No.' in the SWIFT field 70 narrative. To avoid exchange-control friction, the injection must be denominated in a fully convertible currency (USD/AUD/EUR) and should be credited to a CBS-licensed dealer's foreign-currency account, not to a WST account. The IC's registered agent must file the allotment return and maintain a share register entry evidencing the share issuance on the same value date. Documents supporting the inbound remittance are the certificate of incorporation, board resolution approving the allotment, subscription agreement, share certificate, and a UBO certificate; this bundle constitutes the evidentiary reconciliation at account opening and for the bank's periodic EDD review.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements are executed through the IC's settlement account at a Samoa authorized dealer using SWIFT MT103/MT202 for direct vendor payments, licensing fees, and software procurement. Documentary trade collections and Commercial Letters of Credit (sight or usance) are available for physical hardware or cloud-infrastructure purchases when the counterparty requires bank payment undertaking; an LC issued by a Samoa bank should be advised/confirmed through a corresponding bank in the beneficiary's country to mitigate country risk. App-store related disbursements from Apple and Google to the IC occur by net settlement, so no outbound LC is required for those rails; residual cross-border payments for marketing, R&D subcontracts, and legal/accounting services are paid by MT103 with supporting invoices, retaining the underlying service agreement and time-sheet evidence for the bank's CDD file.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore forward purchase/sale of USD against WST between the IC and a CBS-licensed authorized dealer
Cross-currency swap (USD/WST) for a scheduled foreign-currency capital repayment or dividend remittance
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) referencing the WST/USDT exchange rate, settled in USD outside Samoa, where such NDF does not create an onshore WST settlement obligation
Foreign-exchange swap (FX swap) arranged with a licensed dealer for T+2 conversion of USD receipts into WST operating expenses

Vanilla foreign-exchange call/put option (delta-one structured option) with an international investment bank permitted under Samoa exchange-control approvals, provided the premium is paid in USD and no WST lending is involved

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: due within 30 calendar days after each incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of US$100 per month or part month; persistent default triggers a 90-day administrative strike-off notice and subsequent deregistration from the International Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) via licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: submitted annually together with the Annual Return; on-event updates required for any share transfer within the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-confirmation may result in FIU administrative fines of up to SAT$10,000, warning notices, and suspension of the registered agent's license; directors risk personal liability under the AML/CFT Act 2007.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Annual Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: effective on the incorporation anniversary; renewed as a condition of the Annual Return acceptance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent in Samoa renders the company non-compliant; SIFA may strike off the company without Court direction after 90 days' notice in the Samoan Gazette.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies only if the International Company (a) has 10 or more shareholders, (b) has issued invitations to the public to subscribe for shares or debentures, or (c) is a parent company with subsidiaries; otherwise the International Company is exempt from statutory audit under the International Companies Act 1987, s.89.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory GAAP for audit-exempt International Companies; books and records may be maintained under IFRS, US GAAP, or any other internationally recognized accounting framework chosen by the directors. Financial statements are not filed with SIFA for exempt companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent is required to issue an annual UBO confirmation notice to every member; each member must confirm or update their beneficial ownership status. Any share transfer during the year must be accompanied by updated beneficiary declarations before registration is effected. The agent consolidates the annual confirmation and files it with the Samoa FIU. Failure to update on transfer invalidates the transferee's voting rights if not registered.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Member and Director Resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 – USD 1,500 per annum for standard licensed agent fees covering registered office, corporate secretarial services, and annual return preparation
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for audit-exempt International Companies; USD 3,000 – USD 8,000 for companies triggering the mandatory audit threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — the International Company (IC) tax-exempt regime applies under the International Companies Act 1987 s.101 where a valid Tax Exemption Certificate (TEC) is held; the otherwise-applicable resident corporate headline rate under the Income Tax Act 2012 s.38 is 27%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total exemption from Samoan income tax, dividend WHT, interest WHT, royalty WHT, capital gains tax, stamp duty on instrument transfers, and exchange control for the duration of the TEC; no GST (15% domestic GST) exposure on international business conduct; exempt ICs file a nil/exempt annual return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form AITR-C (Annual Income Tax Return for Companies), filed electronically via the Samoa Ministry for Revenue eReturn business portal (mre.gov.ws); the licensed Samoan registered agent lodges the return on behalf of the exempt IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after the fiscal year-end (balance date); a 31 December year-end requires filing by 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and International Company registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the IC TIN and the number issued by the Registrar of International Companies; obtainable from the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name, licence number, and physical Apia office address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must not list their foreign home address; the Samoan registered agent address is mandatory for service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Exemption Certificate reference number and expiry date, with a scanned copy of the certificate annexed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the current TEC; renewal must precede the filing date to preserve the 0% rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income from international business (fitness app subscription, advertising, and telemetry data monetisation).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0 — tax exempt' where the TEC is valid and no Samoan-source income exists; Apple IAP and Google Play Billing revenue is not attributed to Samoa absent a local PE.
Must remain nil; an IC is statutorily barred from trading with Samoan residents. Any positive entry triggers loss of IC status and full taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenditure (matched only against Box 3b income).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Leave nil for the exempt IC; maintain contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation outside the return.
Exempt ICs report nil taxable income; the 5-year loss carryforward mechanism under the Income Tax Act 2012 is only triggered if the exemption is revoked.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax payable at the 27% standard corporate rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Computed as '0' on the exempt position; any corrected assessment must be appealed through the registered agent within 30 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits (foreign tax credits, WHT credits) and net tax payable or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0'; where a foreign jurisdiction withheld on the IC's app revenue, credit claims are pursued in that jurisdiction, not in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration by a director and certification by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident director may sign by scanned signature; the registered agent must countersign to attest authority and accuracy.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or incorrect filing: administrative shortfall penalty of 20% of the understated tax plus 1.5% monthly late-payment interest on outstanding amounts; criminal prosecution with a fine of up to 200 penalty units (SAT 40,000) and/or imprisonment up to 2 years for knowingly false returns.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form TEC-R (Tax Exemption Certificate Renewal and Annual Substance Declaration), lodged by the registered agent with the Samoa Ministry for Revenue; non-resident principals are not granted direct portal access.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the certificate anniversary; renewal is prospective, and any lapse reinstates the 27% resident taxation from the expiry date until the new certificate is granted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC name, registration number, TEC number, and incorporation date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Match the exact registered name; non-resident shareholders' legal identities are disclosed only to the Ministry, never placed on the public register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of continued compliance with ICA 1987 s.101: no business with Samoan residents, no Samoan domestic market activity, no Samoan real property.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offering paid fitness subscriptions to Samoan-resident consumers would breach this declaration and void the certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business activity description covering ISIC 6201 software publishing, revenue channels (Apple IAP, Google Play Billing), and expected annual turnover.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State that all end-users are outside Samoa; the registered agent may attach an app distribution and jurisdiction report.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership particulars (individuals exercising ultimate control), compliant with the AML/CFT Act 2019.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A trust owning the IC must attach the trustee's contact details and the settled beneficiaries' categories, without exposing the trust deed publicly.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent certification of records location, board decision-making, and economic substance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Board meetings may be conducted online; minutes and accounting records must be physically available in Samoa or via the agent for production on demand.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to renew: immediate loss of the exempt regime, retroactive exposure to 27% income tax on the period from expiry, and a late-renewal fee; material misdeclaration allows the Commissioner to revoke the TEC, triggering assessment and director personal liability.
